subject: Request: local-language signoff & translation timeline for SeaAnalytics reference
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Emiko Sato <emiko.sato@seaanalytics.co.jp>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: local-language signoff & translation timeline for SeaAnalytics reference

Hi Emiko —

Thanks again for agreeing to be a reference. Attached is the working draft of the case study we ran by your marketing team (case-study-draft-en.docx) plus the standard consent template and a short CSV with the fields we typically redact. We want to publish a short reference page on our site and two localized variants (Japanese and Simplified Chinese), and also produce single-page PDF assets for EU distribution (DE/FR) where legal asked for a short localized paragraph about data handling.

Can you confirm the following so we can finalize scope and timeline?
- Who on your side will provide official signoff for each language (JP / ZH / DE / FR)?
- Any internal legal or privacy review required for the EU language pages (we noticed earlier you mentioned GDPR review)?
- Are there any phrasing constraints in APAC markets we should avoid (compliance or product naming differences)?
- Preferred publication window (we were aiming for Dec 10–15 but can shift).

Dylan (cc) will handle the technical accuracy pass for the product excerpts; Marissa will coordinate design and the asset build. Once we have names and contacts, we can share the translation-styleguide.zip and put Ling Zhang (webrtc) on a short kickoff.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: case-study-draft-en.docx, reference-consent-template.pdf, redaction-examples.csv
From: Emiko Sato <emiko.sato@seaanalytics.co.jp>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@seaanalytics.co.jp>
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 11:03:00 +09:00
Subject: Re: Request: local-language signoff & translation timeline for SeaAnalytics reference

Hi Vanessa —

Appreciate the draft — looks good. Quick answers below and adding context so we can move quickly: 

1) Signoff owners: 
   - Japanese: Emi Takahashi (Marketing Lead, APAC) — emi.takahashi@seaanalytics.co.jp
   - Simplified Chinese: Ling Zhang (we'll loop her in; she runs translations) — ling.zhang@linguaworks.cn
   - German/French: Legal will require review and signoff; primary reviewer is Markus Klein (Legal Counsel, EU) — markus.klein@seaanalytics.eu

2) GDPR / EU: Yes, legal wants to see a redacted customer list and the consent PDF signed. Procurement is copied for vendor intake (they may need our W-9/equivalent).

3) APAC phrasing: Two items to flag: "session affinity" should be translated carefully in Japanese (we use a different term internally) and avoid the phrase "hosts customer data" — better to say "processes request metadata" in JP/ CN assets. Ling will advise on preferred terminology.

4) Timeline: Procurement / Legal will likely need until Dec 8 for the EU review if everything is in place; JP/CN approvals can be faster (we can turn translations around by Dec 6 if Ling has final copy).

We'll loop Ling and Markus in the next message.

Best,
Emiko Sato
Head of Marketing, SeaAnalytics
emiko.sato@seaanalytics.co.jp

Attachment: procurement checklist noted
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Emiko Sato <emiko.sato@seaanalytics.co.jp>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@seaanalytics.co.jp>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: local-language signoff & translation timeline for SeaAnalytics reference

Thanks Emiko — this is very helpful. Quick operational notes / next steps from our side: 

- Dylan will run a short product accuracy checklist against the English draft and flag any sentences that may be ambiguous for translators. He'll attach the checklist by EOD PT.
- Marissa will prepare a one-page visual asset template (vertical and horizontal) and will include localized copy slots for JP/ZH/DE/FR.
- Vanessa (me) will send the consent PDF to you via DocuSign and cc Markus for EU legal approval. Expect a DocuSign link from us by Tue morning (we'll use the link in related_links).

Can you confirm contact details for Emi Takahashi and Markus Klein so I can add them to the DocuSign flow? Also if procurement needs any specific vendor docs from Redwood (e.g., SOC2 report link or data processing addendum), let us know and we'll attach.

Proposed publication plan (subject to EU legal):
- Dec 6: Final JP/CN localized copy signoff
- Dec 8–9: EU legal review + signoff window
- Dec 10–15: Publish localized pages and downloadable PDFs

If that works, we'll queue the translators and lock the timeline.

Thanks —
Vanessa
From: Ling Zhang <ling.zhang@linguaworks.cn>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Emiko Sato <emiko.sato@seaanalytics.co.jp>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 30 Nov 2026 13:42:00 +08:00
Subject: Re: Request: local-language signoff & translation timeline for SeaAnalytics reference

Hi all —

Thanks for the ping — Ling here from LinguaWorks (translation lead). I can take JP and ZH and confirm we can meet the Dec 6 date if we get the final English copy and the translation-styleguide.zip by end of day Nov 30 UTC. A few notes from the localization side: 

- We'll provide two ZH variants (Simplified for Mainland and a simplified variant for SG/HK if you want a separate copy).
- For Japanese, we recommend using "プロセスクロジック" rather than a literal translation of "session affinity"; if you prefer a different brand-term, flag it before Nov 30.
- Please confirm whether product screenshots need to be localized (we can mask PII and leave UI strings in English if you prefer faster turnaround).

I'll create a brief localization checklist and upload it to the Drive link provided once we have the doc.

Regards,
Ling Zhang
Localization Lead | LinguaWorks
ling.zhang@linguaworks.cn

Attachment: translation-styleguide.zip (requested)

Hi Vanessa / team —

Confirmed: Emi Takahashi (emi.takahashi@seaanalytics.co.jp) and Markus Klein (markus.klein@seaanalytics.eu) are the signoff owners. Procurement has requested our SOC2 link and a short vendor form — I attached the checklist earlier but procurement will follow up separately.

We are ready to receive the DocuSign and the translation guide. Dec 6 for JP/CN and Dec 8 for EU legal review is fine. Please proceed with DocuSign flow and put Markus on the review step for DE/FR. Ling, thanks — please upload the localization checklist and we'll prioritize review.

One last quick ask: on the English draft, can you remove the customer quote that references EU-specific retention settings? Markus wants that quote redacted from the EU copy and replaced with the neutral line suggested in the consent template.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to finalizing.

Best,
Emiko
